
	<div class="postTitle">
		<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/aursordev/p/19297762" title="发布于 2025-12-02 15:07">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">2025年12月的闲谈</span>
    

</a>

	</div>
	<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>2025年12月，接近年底，我准备把我最近一年的开发感悟总结一下</p>
<p>最近一年，我负责的项目主要以多端混合开发为主，以PC端管理系统与配套的H5生态为辅。这段时间中，我发现公司有些同事思考太远，经常会引起不必要的沟通与讨论，可能会持续一个小时。典型的案例就是我目前负责的最新项目，各种考虑深远，各种配套想实现，但现实却带来迎头痛击，小程序被下架。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2000062/202512/2000062-20251202141214905-839047992.png" alt="45b0e332d7adce47d7269ec17ecdc255" width="327" height="250" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>本来可以用最小化核心项目试验，非要搞出很多繁杂的设计步骤，操作过程来耗费多余的开发时间，在业务线试错的背景下，搞一套大而全的东西确实是本末倒置，所以在机会项目的前提下，考虑过于长远并非好的决策。</p>
<p>吐槽完成之后，来总结下从2025年到如今我在开发中的一些经验。</p>
<p>在做小程序项目中，永远不要相信产品经理乃至领导“只做这一端”的鬼话，在我负责第一个跨端项目的时候，领导刚开始说只做微信小程序，然后随着业务的进展，领导又说支付宝小程序有前景，过了一段时间又说，抖音小程序是个趋势，然后又过了一段时间，运营想要小红书小程序...</p>
<p>所以在做技术选型的时候，一定要充分的考虑考虑再考虑，能优先考虑多端技术统一的技术栈就优先考虑，在此，我推荐使用uniapp，网上虽然很多人骂uniapp这不好那不好，但是实际上uniapp在国内的中小企业开发环境下，实在是一个比较好的选择，搭配针对Uniapp的脚手架，uni-helper 或者 uni-best 等上层框架，开发体验会好很多。</p>
<p>再来说一下架构设计这一方面，由于使用了Uniapp这个底层框架，大部分情况下，我们不需要去考虑偏底层的设计，如页面路由怎么选啊，request请求库怎么选啊，数据缓存怎么做啊，身份鉴权怎么做啊等等，由于小程序端的天然限制，大部分都有平台提供的API可以使用，我们只需要针对这些API，做恰到好处的架构设计就可以了，最典型的例子就是：“登录与用户数据获取”，这个需要考虑的就比较多，比如登录之后，用户数据怎么同步，未登录的时候，怎么针对用户进行登录，由于产品经理的设计，用户未登录不影响用户查阅数据，而不是跳转到一个专门的登录页面（只针对C端），这里我的解决方案是：pinia / mitt / 无渲染组件 / 跨平台Login逻辑，这里来说明一下：</p>
<p>1. pinia 是为了全局存储用户数据，相信大家都明白，一页项目可能在非常多的页面都要使用用户信息数据，所以这里存全局；</p>
<p>2. mitt 发布订阅模式是为了做针对用户数据的更新，这种方法是最简单的更新用户数据的地方，在一个地方处理数据，在任意地方发布事件，代码如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span> { USER_UPDATE_KEY } from <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'@/global/key'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span> emitter from <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'./emitter'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span> { getUserInfo } from <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'@/api/me'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span> { useUserStore } from <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'@/stores/useUserStore'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span> { cloneDeep, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span> } from <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'lodash-es'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span> { useGlobalStore } from <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'../stores/useGlobalStore'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 很多代码</span></pre>
<div>
<div>　　export const subscribeUserUpdate = (fn: () =&gt; void) =&gt; {</div>
<div>&nbsp; 　　emitter.on(USER_UPDATE_KEY, fn);</div>
<div>　　};</div>
</div>
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

const getUser </span>= async () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  const user </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> await getUserInfo();
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (user?.data?.code === 200<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
    const userStore </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> useUserStore();
    userStore.setUser(user.data.data);
  }
};

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 网络监听</span>
export <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> onNetworkStatusChange() {
  uni.onNetworkStatusChange(res </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    const store </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> useGlobalStore();
    store.state.isConnected </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> res.isConnected;
  });
}

export </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> boot() {
  subscribeUserUpdate(getUser);
  setCurrentLocation();
  onNetworkStatusChange();
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>然后在App.vue生命周期中执行boot函数，就可以开启监听了</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">onLaunch(async () =&gt; {
  platformUpdate();
  boot();
  await loginIfNotToken();
});</span></pre>
</div>
<p>然后想要更新用户数据的时候，只需要发布一个事件就OK了，为什么选用mitt而不是pinia action,最大的区别就是我可以针对这个事件发布来做信息更新以外的事情，比如，用户信息更新了，可能要触发一个其他的日志统计接口，写到action中会让这些逻辑耦合在一起</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre> emitter.emit(USER_UPDATE_KEY);</pre>
</div>
<p>3. 无渲染组件，因为有很多功能是需要用户登录才可以使用的，但是也不能给所有的功能都写一个&lt;button open-type="getphonenumber"&gt;这种，所以要封装一个通用的组件来自动处理这个功能。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">lang</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="ts"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> setup</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import { useUserStore } from </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@/stores/useUserStore</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
import { miniAppLogin } from </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@/utils/auth</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
import type { ButtonOnGetphonenumberEvent } from </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@uni-helper/uni-types</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

interface Props {
  isCustomAuthDoneNextProcess</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">?</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  customNextFunction</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">?</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: () </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=&gt;</span> <span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
}

const props </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> withDefaults(defineProps</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Props</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(), {
  isCustomAuthDoneNextProcess: </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
});

const { isCustomAuthDoneNextProcess } </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> toRefs(props);

const userStore </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> useUserStore();
const isLogin </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> computed(() </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> userStore.user.userId);

async </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> miniAppLoginDecorator(res: ButtonOnGetphonenumberEvent) {
  miniAppLogin(
    res,
    isCustomAuthDoneNextProcess.value </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">?</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> props.customNextFunction : undefined
  );
}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">view </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">v-if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="!isLogin"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="relative"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">slot </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">view </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="absolute left-0 top-0 h-full w-full opacity-0"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> #ifdef MP-WEIXIN </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">button

        class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="h-full w-full"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
        @getphonenumber</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="miniAppLoginDecorator"</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        登录
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">button</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">&lt;!--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> #endif </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">view</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">view</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">slot </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">v-else </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这便是我的做法，通过登录标识判断是否登录了，如果登录了之后则渲染原来的组件，否则给button做绝对定位覆盖在插槽上</p>
<p>4. 跨平台Login登录，在最开始的项目中因为要做微信/支付宝/ios(后来废弃)的登录，那么我就要统一入口，根据条件编译实现多平台的代码，代码如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span> { login } from <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">"@uni-helper/uni-promises"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span> { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span> } from <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">"lodash-es"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span> { postMiniAppLogin, postMiniAppPhone } from <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">"@/api/me"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span> { useGlobalStore } from <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">"@/stores/useGlobalStore"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span> { alipayGetPhone, alipayLogin } from <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">"@/api/login"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> #ifdef MP-WEIXIN</span>
export <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GetPhoneNumberArguments {
  detail: {
    [key </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">"iv"</span> | <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">"encryptedData"</span> | <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">"errMsg"</span> | <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">"code"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]: string;
  };
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> #endif</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*@description 后端为了兼容APP获取关注微信公众号获取用户手机号的逻辑，增加了一个备用字段 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
export async </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">function</span> loginAndGetToken(payload =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {}) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> #ifdef MP-WEIXIN</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    await loginAndGetTokenWeixin(payload);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> #endif</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> #ifdef MP-ALIPAY</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    await loginAndGetTokenAlipay();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> #endif</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> #ifdef MP-WEIXIN</span>
async <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">function</span> loginAndGetTokenWeixin(payload =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {}) {
  const globalStore </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> useGlobalStore();
  const globalState </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> globalStore.state;
  const wxloginCode </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> await uni.login();
  const miniAppRes </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> await postMiniAppLogin(
    wxloginCode.code,
    globalState.appId,
    payload,
  );
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>(miniAppRes.data, <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">"data.token"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
    uni.setStorageSync(</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">"TOKEN"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, miniAppRes.data.data.token);
}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> #endif</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> #ifdef MP-ALIPAY</span>
async <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> loginAndGetTokenAlipay() {
  const globalStore </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> useGlobalStore();
  const globalState </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> globalStore.state;
  const aliloginCode </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> await login();
  const res </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> await alipayLogin(globalState.appId, aliloginCode.code);
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>(res.data, <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">"data.token"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
    uni.setStorageSync(</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">"TOKEN"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, res.data.data.token);
}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> #endif</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 *
 * @param e 这里是只有微信小程序才会有回调函数
 * @param next 这里是为了复用登录逻辑，但是想打断绑定手机号之后跳转其他页面的逻辑
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

export async </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">function</span> miniAppLogin(e?: AnyObject, next?: () =&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {

<p>说完用户登录与信息获取，再来说一下常用的场景，比如数据列表，做C端经常会遇到这种场景，那么要封装一个统一的组件来处理，因为在小程序中，写一套触底加载，下拉刷新，数据列表渲染真的很累，所以设计一个泛型组件来实现这个功能是非常合适的，我这里的实现方案如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">lang</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="ts"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> setup generic</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="T"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import { loadingRequestDecorator } from </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@/utils/common</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
import { cloneDeep, get } from </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">lodash-es</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>

<span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
interface TypeResponse {
  list: Array</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">T</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  total: number
}

interface Props {
  height: string
  scrollClassNames</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">?</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: string
  immediate</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">?</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  load: (params: { page: number; size: number }) </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Promise</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">TypeResponse</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}

const props </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> withDefaults(defineProps</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Props</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(), {
  immediate: </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
})
const { height } </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> toRefs(props)

const loading </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ref(</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

const currentPage </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ref(</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">1</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

const hasNext </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ref(</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
const total </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ref(</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">0</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

const data </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> shallowRef</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">TypeResponse[</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">list</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">([])
</span>

<span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * @description 加载数据
 </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
async </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> loadData() {
  </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">!</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">loading.value) {
    </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这里是 如果是 列表没有数据的时候才会给他设置为true,分页加载数据的时候没必要展示骨架屏</span>
<span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    loading.value </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> data.value.length </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">===</span> <span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">0</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

    loadingRequestDecorator(async () </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
      const list </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> await props.load({
        page: currentPage.value,
        size: currentSize.value,
      })

      </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 表示刷新，则覆盖数据</span>
      <span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (refreshing.value) {
        data.value </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> list.list
        refreshing.value </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span> <span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      } </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        data.value </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [...data.value, ...list.list]
      }

      total.value </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> list.total
      hasNext.value </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> total.value </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> data.value.length
</span>
<span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      setTimeout(() </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        loading.value </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">&amp;&amp;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (loading.value </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span> <span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
      }, </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">10</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    }, </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">加载失败</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
  }
}

</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> onReachBottom() {
  </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (hasNext.value) {

async </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> onRefresh() {

  </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> #ifdef MP-ALIPAY</span>

</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> updateOne(callback: (item: AnyObject) </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TypeResponse[</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">list</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]) {

</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*@description 获取的是拷贝的数据，不会有响应式数据</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>

  </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cloneDeep(data.value)
}

</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*@description 全量数据更新 </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
async </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> onAllListUpdate() {
  </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    const response </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> await props.load({
      page: </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">1</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
      size: data.value.length,
    })

    const newTotal </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> get(response, </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">total</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">0</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    const list </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> get(response, </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">list</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, [])
    const pageNewNum </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Math.ceil(list.length </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">/</span> <span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">10</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 向上取整</span>
<span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    currentPage.value </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pageNewNum
    total.value </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> newTotal
    data.value </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> list
  } </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (e) {
    console.warn(</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">scrollLoadData:onAllListUpdate 更新接口失败!</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    console.log(</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">error:</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, e)
  }
}

defineExpose({ reset: exposeReset, updateOne, getUnRefList, onAllListUpdate })

onMounted(() </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">=&gt;</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  </span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="background-color: rgba(245, 245, 245, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (props.immediate) loadData()
})
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">script</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">scroll-view
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">:class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="scrollClassNames || ''"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    :refresher-enabled</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="true"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    :refresher-triggered</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="refreshing"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    :scroll-y</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="true"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    :style</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="{ height }"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    @refresherrefresh</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="onRefresh"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
    @scrolltolower</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="onReachBottom"</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">slot </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">:data</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="data"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> :loading</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="loading"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>

  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">scroll-view</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>因为支付宝小程序不支持scroll-view的下拉刷新，所以这里做兼容处理，支持自动、手动获取数据，单数据更新，重置等功能，使用起来也是非常简单，只需要提供一个load函数，与一些简单配置即可，使用示例：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">scroll-load-data </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">ref</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="consumeRef"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> :load</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="getList"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> :height</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="scrollHeight"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">#default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="{ data }"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="grid grid-gap-24rpx"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> v-if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="data.length"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">currency-document
              </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">v-for</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="i in data"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
              :title</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="computedTitle(i.type)"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
              :time</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="formatDate(i.createTime)"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
              type</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="consume"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
              :operateAmount</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="i.operateAmount"</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
              <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">span</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>沟通求职者：{{ i.workerInfo.name }}<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">span</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">currency-document</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">v-else class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="mt-60rpx"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">empty-state</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span> 暂无数据 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">empty-state</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">div</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">template</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">scroll-load-data</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>在做复杂条件判断的时候尽量使用策略模式来做，尤其是很多条件那种，这个例子是计算哪些日期在业务上是可拖动的逻辑，</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 根据入参的x坐标和y坐标，计算当前在x轴第几项与y轴第几项</span>
const calculatePoint = () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  const touchOrder </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> getTouchOrder(lastTouchPoint.value);
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这里则代表该点是逻辑可选的，但是并不代表业务可选</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (touchOrder &amp;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> touchOrder.isCanReceive) {
    const validatePipe </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [
      isOverRangeOrEndPointIfStartPointPass,
      isOverRangeOrEndPointIfEndPointPass
    ];
    const isValid </span>= validatePipe.every(validateFn =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> validateFn(touchOrder));
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">isValid) {
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> return showToast({ title: '请选择一个可用的时间', icon: 'none' });</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 校验通过后，更新当前选中的时间段</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (currentDragOrderIsStartTime.value) {
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> currentStartTime.value = touchOrder.time;</span>
      emit(<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'update:currentStartTime'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, touchOrder.time);
    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> currentEndTime.value = touchOrder.time;</span>
      emit(<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">'update:currentEndTime'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, touchOrder.time);
    }
  }
};</span></pre>
</div>

<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;针对TS的一些经验，目前我在项目中针对Api接口等非vue文件中的类型定义，统一放在dto文件夹下，针对常用类型，比如ResponseBody写在dto/common.dto.ts文件下</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>export <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span> ResponseBody&lt;T&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  code: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">number</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  msg: string;
  data: T;
}
export </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OssDto {
  accessKeyId: string;
  policy: string;
  signature: string;
  dir: string;
  host: string;
  callback: string;
  expire: string;
}

export </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OssDtoData {
  code: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">number</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  msg: string;
  data: OssDto;
}

export </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Poi {
  address: string;

export </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Pager {
  page: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">number</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
  size: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">number</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>类型的一些使用经验，要善于使用内置工具类型，如Pick,Partial,Record 等类型，好的类型定义让代码结构更清晰，取interface中的一个字段的类型，可以使用 User['name'] 这种方式，取数组元素可以使用 UserList[number]这种</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2000062/202512/2000062-20251202150044820-1047752873.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;要约束字符串类型，可以使用字符串字面量类型，也可以使用模板字符串类型等等</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>今天先写到这把，<span style="text-decoration: underline; color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">小程序会让人变得不幸。。。</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
